messages:
Ravi: Helix asks for a migration POC from CompetitorX -> Redwood. They saw truncation and tone differences in smoke tests. Need quick plan for eval, security Qs, and POC pricing.
Ana: Ask them for 25-30 sample prompts and their acceptance criteria (exact match vs semantic).
Kai: Likely causes: tokenizer off-by-one, role mapping, sampling variance. Recommend temp=0 deterministic run for parity check and canonicalize inputs (normalize unicode + explicit EOS).
Lou: Security asks: KMS control, audit logs, data residency. Offer Hosted POC with retention=7d + Private/Dedicated options for keys-in-customer-KMS. Send security pack.
BillingBot: Proposed promo: 14-day Hosted credit up to 200k tokens; convert credit to Dedicated commit if they sign within 30 days (subject to finance).
Ravi: Ops can we spin up a compat endpoint for them?
BillingBot: provisioned endpoint helix-compat-2823 (model=rwd-compat-3.1, retention=7d)
Ana: Once they send eval set we'll run our harness, produce a diff spreadsheet, and call out top-10 divergence patterns for triage.
Kai: I'll draft a small shim example to map competitor payload -> Redwood messages and a normalization checklist.
Lou: I'll email the security pack and note network ACL items for Private.
Ravi: Action items: 1) Ravi -> request eval set + acceptance criteria (today) 2) Ana -> run harness on helix-compat-2823 and share diffs (tomorrow) 3) Lou -> send security pack (EOD) 4) Billing -> finalize POC quote and promo (today).
